headline: When to Choose a Detached ADU Over Other Options
articleBody:
Deciding on the best way to add space to your Los Angeles home can feel like a puzzle. While attached ADUs and garage conversions are fantastic, sometimes a detached ADU in your backyard is the perfect solution. But how do you know if it’s the right fit for your property and goals?

Consider a detached ADU if you're looking for maximum privacy. Since it’s a separate structure, it offers a distinct sense of independence, ideal for rental income, an in-law suite, or even a quiet home office away from the main house's hustle and bustle. It also allows for more design flexibility. You're not tied to the existing footprint or style of your main home, so you can create a truly unique space that perfectly matches its purpose.

Another great reason is property value. A well-built, detached ADU can significantly increase your property's appeal and market value, especially in competitive Los Angeles neighborhoods. Plus, if your main home already has a garage you rely on, a detached ADU means you won't have to sacrifice that valuable parking or storage space. It’s also often easier to manage noise and disruption during construction, as the work is happening in a separate area of your property. If you're looking for a completely self-sufficient unit with its own distinct identity, a detached ADU might just be your best bet.
